ed25519-donna, vendored unmodified from
https://github.com/floodyberry/ed25519-donna @ 8757bd4cd209cb032853ece0ce413f122eef212c

License: public domain (Andrew M. <liquidsun@gmail.com>), see the header of
ed25519.c. The SHA-512 used when ED25519_REFHASH is defined is part of the same
public-domain distribution.

Neon Relay builds this translation unit with -DED25519_REFHASH so that no
OpenSSL dependency is required; signing volume is tiny (match events), so the
reference hash is acceptable.
